packageManifest.description: Genshin Impact v7.0 JSON data. Search and get results in all in-game languages! Sources from the fandom wiki and GenshinData repo.
packageManifest.gameVersionBinding: Provider package description explicitly binds this exact package manifest to Genshin Impact v7.0.

fields.effect4Pc: Increases the equipping character's CRIT Rate by 16%, and their Stellar Swirl reaction dealt by 40%, for 10s after they trigger a Stellar Swirl reaction.

Increases the equipping character's ATK by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Also increases Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members by 50%. The above effects can trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field, and he DMG bonus from multiple Artifact Sets with the same name do not stack.

verification.rawBytes: Downloaded exact response bytes without JSON normalization.
verification.sha256: SHA-256 over each retained raw file byte sequence.
verification.gitBlobSha: Git SHA-1 over the byte sequence prefixed by blob <byteLength>\0; recomputed values equal the upstream Git blob identifiers.
verification.recordIdentity: Each record's id/name pair is taken from the retained raw record; official name mapping is compared separately.
